overview_description.description:
Lumii.me is an innovative AI-powered platform designed to transform mental health and wellbeing in schools. Using our proprietary Large Mental Health Model (LMHM), Lumii.me provides students with real-time emotional support, helping them build resilience, develop coping strategies, and access a safe space to express their feelings.

For educators, Lumii.life offers a confidential wellbeing tool to help staff manage stress, enhance resilience, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Together, Lumii.me and Lumii.life create a holistic approach to mental health, addressing the needs of both students and staff.

Based in the UAE, Lumii.me is proud to be a home-grown business contributing to the region’s reputation as a hub for innovation. With a focus on privacy and cultural adaptability, the platform ensures compliance with global data protection standards, including GDPR, while being tailored to diverse educational environments.

Operating at the intersection of EdTech and mental health, Lumii.me is scalable, adaptable, and poised to lead the transformation of wellbeing in education globally.

about_short_description.short_description: Lumii.me: AI-powered platform revolutionising mental health in schools with real-time support for students & wellbeing tools for staff.

product.name: Lumii.me AI-Powered Wellbeing Assistant
product.description: An AI-driven platform that engages students daily to monitor emotional wellbeing, detect early signs of distress, and provide real-time safeguarding alerts to schools.

product.name: Lumii.me Wellbeing Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard that converts daily student interactions into real-time emotional trend data and safeguarding alerts for school staff to monitor and respond effectively.

product.name: Lumii.me AI-Powered Emotional Triage System
product.description: An AI system that analyzes student conversations to identify emotional states and safeguarding risks, categorizing them with a traffic-light alert system for early school intervention.

product.name: Lumii.me Staff Wellbeing Platform (Lumii.me+)
product.description: A private AI-driven platform providing mental health and emotional support tools for school staff, ensuring confidentiality and no data monitoring by schools.
